frontend_reference: gyeonjwo_frontend dev: candidate.dart, work_queue_repository_impl.dart; candidate methods still use preview data source until frontend switches to HTTP

PUT /api/v1/work-cases/{case_id}/candida.response: 200 {data:{case_id,candidate_set_id,revision,selection_revision,selected_supplier_ids,drafts:[{draft_id,supplier_id,dispatch_state}],selection_policy},meta:{request_id}}. 200 is selection/draft acceptance, never Gmail SENT.

policy.targets: User selects case candidates; mailbox allowed_supplier_ids is never target selection and never edited by this API. Retain effective recipient/purpose/case scope and explicit supplier_ids if present. Empty explicit supplier_ids permits none.
policy.ON: WAITING_APPROVAL; existing APIs16-19 then guarded claim
policy.OFF: Only chosen suppliers and configured permission scope may AUTO_QUEUED. Candidate caution requires manual confirmation. Sender unavailable blocks new automatic submission before mutation. Final current-policy check remains atomic at DB claim.
policy.pending_team_agreement: Whether mailbox allowlist remains independent restriction must be agreed with frontend/DB; no removal assumed.

storage.candidate_set: Completed CANDIDATE agent_runs.output_jsonb.candidate_set, immutable; id equals run UUID; owner/case/input_revision/review_batch_id checked. No new SQL/table created here.
storage.selection: workflow_logs event CANDIDATE_SELECTION payload is full CandidateSelectionResponse. One selection per candidate set; new key cannot replace an already chosen/sending/unknown intent.
storage.drafts: Graph creates private proposals with real IDs. API-12 publishes selected only and atomically retires unselected proposals as FAILED with safe CANDIDATE_NOT_SELECTED reason; never sends them. Retired proposals stay hidden. Do not leave terminal private DRAFTs blocking commit_review. Selected IDs remain unchanged for evidence checks.

lookup_case_candidate_selection_request.returns: NONE, REPLAY(http_status=200,response), or ERROR(code). Immutable original response replay before status/revision guards; method/path/user/key/body hash verified.

submit_case_candidate_selection.returns: ACCEPTED or REPLAY with http_status=200,response full envelope; ERROR(code).
transaction: begin_api_request, case/set/selection/settings locks and revision validation in one DB connection/transaction
Verify current owned set and selectable members, current registered contacts/evidence, no conflicting or UNKNOWN intent; request IDs are not authority
Open common RFQ round for selected targets and publish exactly their staged drafts. No duplicate trigger-owned RFQ rows
Evaluate current effective ON/OFF and retained mailbox scope. No permission widening. Enforce caution; off eligible needs p_dispatch_ready
Save selection audit/full first response and complete_api_request atomically; rollback all on errors

Atomically retire all unselected proposals in this candidate set/batch as FAILED/CANDIDATE_NOT_SELECTED (no provider call); leave no unresolved terminal unselected DRAFT that would block existing commit_review. If equivalent lifecycle is agreed, health must attest that closure guard.

rpc_required.graph_functions: Updated graph_start.json defines stage_case_graph_draft, finish_case_graph_candidate_run, complete_case_graph_run and schedule_case_graph_continuations.

send_guard: Promotion: producer=rfq-v1,candidate_selection_required=true,candidate_selection={state:SELECTED,case_id,candidate_set_id,supplier_id,revision,selection_revision}. DB submit_rfq_draft_action and claim_mail_send must lock/recheck latest set, trusted selection, revision, intent, caution, policy and permissions. Python screening alone is insufficient. No unselected draft via new ID/key/round or approval bypass.
errors: Foreign/missing404; invalid members422 INVALID_CANDIDATE_SELECTION; input409 REVISION_CONFLICT; set409 CANDIDATES_CHANGED; repeat-body replay; different-body409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; concurrent409 REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS; UNKNOWN409 SEND_RESULT_UNKNOWN; missing storage503 CANDIDATE_SELECTION_INTEGRATION_REQUIRED.
rollout: Keep AGENT_GRAPH_ENABLED=false until DB functions/guards and frontend live wiring are deployed and integration-tested. No remote DDL, SQL file, .env change or auto-publication performed.
